get.summary: List document snapshots for a coordination issue (REST v2.0)
get.description:
Returns all document snapshots associated with the coordination issue. Each snapshot
represents a point-in-time capture of a document revision linked to the issue.

The response includes the snapshot metadata (`document_container_id`,
`document_revision_id`, `document_revision_version_id`, `created_at`) and the nested
`prostore_file` object with file URL, name, content type, and viewable status.

No pagination — all snapshots for the issue are returned in a single response.

200.description: OK — all document snapshots for the coordination issue

items.description:
Rendered by `CoordinationIssueDocumentSnapshotBlueprint` view `:normal`. Represents a point-in-time
snapshot image of a document revision linked to a coordination issue. The `prostore_file` nested object
provides the file URL, name, content type, and viewable status.

document_container_id.description: The document container (folder) the source document belongs to.

document_name.description:
Human-readable name of the source document. Surfaced as the coordination issue's
source file for outside-workflow (document snapshot) issues. May be null for snapshots
created before this field existed.

document_revision_id.description: The document revision id from which the snapshot was taken.

document_revision_version_id.description: The specific document revision version id for this snapshot.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created.

prostore_file.description:
Prostore file object (`ProstoreFileBlueprint` view `:normal_with_viewable`). Contains the snapshot
image file details including a signed URL, content type, and whether the file is viewable.

url.description: Signed download URL for the snapshot file.

viewable.description: Whether this file has a viewable document representation.

post.summary: Create a document snapshot on a coordination issue (REST v2.0)
post.description:
Creates a new document snapshot linked to the coordination issue. The `snapshot_upload_uuid`
must reference a previously uploaded file (via the Procore upload flow).

The `DocumentSnapshotCreator` service creates a `ProstoreFile` from the upload UUID
using `ProstoreFileCreator`. The snapshot record is then created with the resolved
file and the provided document container/revision identifiers.

A uniqueness constraint prevents duplicate snapshots for the same `prostore_file` on the
same coordination issue (scoped to non-deleted records).

schema.description:
Flat request body for creating a document snapshot on a coordination issue. The
`snapshot_upload_uuid` identifies a previously uploaded file (via Procore's upload flow).
The service creates a `ProstoreFile` from the upload UUID using `ProstoreFileCreator`
and links it to the new snapshot record.

snapshot_upload_uuid.description:
UUID of the previously uploaded snapshot file. The server creates the corresponding
`ProstoreFile` using `ProstoreFileCreator`.

document_container_id.description: The document container (folder) the source document belongs to.

document_name.description:

source file for outside-workflow (document snapshot) issues. Optional; limited to
255 characters by a database check constraint.

document_revision_id.description: The document revision id from which the snapshot was taken.

document_revision_version_id.description: The specific document revision version id for this snapshot (optional).

patch.summary: Update a document snapshot on a coordination issue (REST v2.0)
patch.description:
Updates the document snapshot by replacing the existing `ProstoreFile` with a new one
created from the provided `snapshot_upload_uuid`. The old `ProstoreFile` is destroyed
after the snapshot is updated.

The `DocumentSnapshotUpdater` service validates the upload UUID, creates a new
`ProstoreFile` using `ProstoreFileCreator`, updates the snapshot record, and then
destroys the old file.

schema.description:
Flat request body for updating a document snapshot on a coordination issue. The
`snapshot_upload_uuid` identifies a previously uploaded file (via Procore's upload flow).
The service creates a new `ProstoreFile` from the upload UUID, updates the snapshot
record, and destroys the old `ProstoreFile`.

snapshot_upload_uuid.description:
UUID of the new uploaded snapshot file. The server creates a new `ProstoreFile`
from this upload, replaces the existing file on the snapshot, and destroys the
old `ProstoreFile`.

document_name.description:
Human-readable name of the source document. Optional; when provided it updates the
snapshot's stored name. Limited to 255 characters by a database check constraint.
